name: Wifoz
description: A tabby cat who lives in the card: sits, loafs, grooms, yawns, walks, runs, rolls over, pounces, climbs and scratches its edges, chases a butterfly, plays with yarn, jumps at a toy on a string and naps, doing more the more room the card gives him. Tap him to pet him; tap anywhere else for a laser dot to chase, or hold and drag to lead it.
